title: LayerCanvas: Infographic Generation in AI Learning Assistants via Hybrid Layer-Set Diffusion
title_zh: LayerCanvas：通过混合图层集扩散模型实现 AI 学习助手中的信息图生成

paragraphs.en: LayerCanvas 是一种通过混合图层集扩散模型来生成信息图的方法，旨在结合 SVG 的结构优势和扩散模型的美学灵活性。 Online learning platforms are increasingly deploying AI assistants to provide personalized, on-demand tutoring. These can leverage infographics to communicate complex information and improve the learning experience. However, automating effective infographic generation remains a challenging task, requiring a combination of visual richness with precise typography, structured layouts, and continued editability. Existing representation methods satisfy these goals only in part: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) representations preserve geometry, hierarchy, and text but provide limited aesthetic flexibility, while raster diffusion models produce richer appearances by flattening content and layout into a single image. Conditioning a diffusion model on a rasterized SVG does not resolve this conflict because the raster preserves approximate placement but discards element ownership, occlusion relationships, and the structure needed to modify and recompose the result. We introduce LayerCanvas, a hybrid approach that retains SVG as the semantic, structural, and typographic program while using diffusion to aestheticize non-text content. Rather than generating one flattened raster, LayerCanvas partitions SVG elements into z-ordered sets of mutually non-overlapping elements and processes them through communicating parallel RGB generation streams. The resulting layers are independently editable and deterministically recomposed, while text is rendered from preserved vector metadata. Our approach combines rich visual synthesis with accurate typography and localized editing. LayerCanvas substantially improves text fidelity over state-of-the-art raster image generators while achieving the highest overall aesthetic quality. We further demonstrate non-destructive content editing, localization, asset reuse, and animation.
paragraphs.zh: LayerCanvas 是一种通过混合图层集扩散模型来生成信息图的方法，旨在结合 SVG 的结构优势和扩散模型的美学灵活性。在线学习平台正越来越多地部署人工智能助手，以提供个性化、按需的辅导服务。 这些平台可以利用信息图来传达复杂信息并提升学习体验。 然而，实现有效的信息图自动生成仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，需要在视觉丰富性与精确的排版、结构化布局以及持续的编辑能力之间取得平衡。 现有的表示方法仅部分实现了这些目标：可扩展矢量图形（SVG）表示能够保留几何形状、层级结构和文本，但美学灵活性有限；而光栅扩散模型通过将内容和布局扁平化为单张图像，能生成更丰富的视觉效果。 将光栅化的 SVG 作为条件输入扩散模型无法解决这一冲突，因为光栅化虽然保留了元素的大致位置，却丢弃了元素的归属关系、遮挡关系以及修改和重组结果所需的结构信息。 我们提出了 LayerCanvas，一种混合方法：它保留 SVG 作为语义、结构和排版的程序基础，同时利用扩散模型对非文本内容进行美学优化。 LayerCanvas 不会生成单一的扁平化光栅图像，而是将 SVG 元素划分为按 z 轴排序的互不重叠元素集合，并通过相互通信的并行 RGB 生成流进行处理。 最终生成的各层可以独立编辑并确定性地重组，而文本则通过保留的矢量元数据渲染出来。 我们的方法结合了丰富的视觉合成能力、精确的排版和局部编辑功能。 LayerCanvas 在文本保真度方面显著优于当前最先进的光栅图像生成器，同时实现了最高的整体美学质量。 我们还展示了非破坏性内容编辑、局部修改、资产复用和动画功能。
